title: GraphDC：一种用于可扩展图算法推理的分治多智能体系统
summary: GraphDC是一个分治多智能体框架，通过将输入图分解为子图、分配给专门智能体进行局部推理，并由主智能体整合信息，从而提升LLM在图算法推理任务上的性能，尤其在大型图实例上表现优异。
summary_en: GraphDC is a divide-and-conquer multi-agent framework that decomposes input graphs into subgraphs, assigns them to specialized agents for local reasoning, and uses a master agent to integrate information, improving LLM performance on graph algorithm reasoning, especially on large instances.
